title: CauProphet: Teaching Agents to Develop Causal Cognition like Humans
title_zh: CauProphet：教会智能体像人类一样发展因果认知

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled a new class of agents capable of perceiving environments, acting through tools, and pursuing goals [ Wang et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ] . Within this space, a particularly influential category has emerged in the form of general-purpose autonomous assistants, including Claude Code [ Anthropic, 2025a ] , Codex [ OpenAI, 2025 ] , Hermes [ Nous Research, 2026 ] , and OpenClaw [ OpenClaw, 2025 ] , which interact with users through multi-turn dialogue to address requests involving data analysis, writing, coding, and research. Much of what makes these assistants capable lies not in the base model alone but in the surrounding system—tool interfaces, context management, and safety constraints—that governs the model’s behavior through repeated cycles of reasoning, tool use, and observation [ Yao et al., 2023 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）催生了一类新型智能体，它们能够感知环境、通过工具采取行动并追求目标 [ Wang et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ] 。 在这一领域中，出现了一类影响尤为深远的通用自主助手，包括 Claude Code [ Anthropic, 2025a ] 、Codex [ OpenAI, 2025 ] 、Hermes [ Nous Research, 2026 ] 和 OpenClaw [ OpenClaw, 2025 ] ，它们通过多轮对话与用户交互，以处理涉及数据分析、写作、编程和研究等方面的请求。 这些助手之所以强大，很大程度上并非仅源于基础模型本身，而是源于其周边系统——包括工具接口、上下文管理与安全约束——正是这些系统通过推理、工具使用与观察的反复循环来约束模型的行为 [ Yao et al., 2023 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Causality investigates how entities influence one another beyond superficial correlations. It provides the conceptual and mathematical foundation for asking why observed patterns arise, what would happen under an intervention, and what would have occurred under an alternative condition [ Pearl, 2009 ; Peters et al., 2017 ] . Causal analysis involves identifying the factors that influence an outcome, proposing explanations of how they do so, and examining the evidence and assumptions behind these explanations [ Spirtes et al., 2001 ; Hernán and Robins, 2020 ; Sharma and Kiciman, 2020 ; Blöbaum et al., 2024 ] . Users may need such analysis for their tasks even when they lack expertise in causality. When choosing actions to achieve user goals, LLM agents need to distinguish observed associations from the changes their actions would cause [ Pearl, 2009 ; Kiciman et al., 2024 ] . Without this distinction, agents may provide plausible but unreliable explanations of why something happens.
paragraphs.zh: 因果性研究的是超越表面相关性的、实体之间如何相互影响。 它为以下问题提供了概念和数学基础：为什么会出现所观察到的模式，在干预之下会发生什么，以及在另一种条件下本会发生什么 [ Pearl, 2009 ; Peters et al., 2017 ] 。 因果分析包括识别影响某个结果的因素，提出关于它们如何产生影响的解释，并检验这些解释背后的证据和假设 [ Spirtes et al., 2001 ; Hernán and Robins, 2020 ; Sharma and Kiciman, 2020 ; Blöbaum et al., 2024 ] 。 即使缺乏因果性方面的专业知识，用户在完成任务时也可能需要此类分析。 在选择行动以实现用户目标时，LLM 智能体需要区分观察到的关联与其行动将引起的变化 [ Pearl, 2009 ; Kiciman et al., 2024 ] 。 缺乏这种区分，智能体可能会对某事为何发生给出看似合理却不可靠的解释。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on LLMs and causality follows two main directions: constructing causal knowledge and using it to guide agent behavior. The first automates causal analysis or develops methods for identifying causal relationships and estimating effects [ Roy et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026a ; Peng et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Verma et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ] ; applying its findings to later tasks also requires retaining what was learned and when it applies. The second uses causal knowledge to guide decisions and program improvement [ Chen et al., 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ] , with reasoning organized around specific environments or programs. These approaches leave open how agents can accumulate causal understanding across experiences as human beings do. Children learn causal relationships through observation and action and use this knowledge to predict outcomes in new situations [ Gopnik et al., 2004 ] . More broadly, human beings draw on an understanding of how events influence one another [ Sloman and Lagnado, 2015 ] to guide decisions without recalling every experience that shaped it.
paragraphs.zh: 近期关于大语言模型与因果性的工作主要沿两个方向展开：构建因果知识，以及利用因果知识指导智能体行为。 第一个方向是自动化因果分析，或开发用于识别因果关系和估计效应的方法 [ Roy et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026a ; Peng et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Verma et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ] ；将所学成果应用于后续任务，还需要保留所学内容及其适用条件。 第二个方向利用因果知识来指导决策和程序改进 [ Chen et al., 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ] ，其推理围绕特定环境或程序组织。 这些方法尚未解决智能体如何像人类一样跨经验积累因果理解的问题。 儿童通过观察和行动学习因果关系，并利用这些知识在新情境中预测结果 [ Gopnik et al., 2004 ] 。 更广泛地说，人类凭借对事件之间如何相互影响的理解 [ Sloman and Lagnado, 2015 ] 来指导决策，而无需回忆塑造这一理解的每一段经历。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet (Figure 1 ), an LLM agent that accumulates and refines causal knowledge through experience. Within CauProphet , Causal Cognition organizes what the agent learns around recurring factors, how they influence outcomes, and the conditions under which these relationships hold. For a new task, the agent checks which retained explanations fit the current circumstances and combines them with current evidence to form a Causal Belief. This structured belief describes what influences the outcome and how possible actions could change it, guiding the agent’s decisions. The same cognition can therefore inform different beliefs as the task and its evidence change. As observations arrive, the agent revises its current belief and updates Causal Cognition with selected findings that may inform later decisions. Through this cycle, causal understanding remains useful even when the original experiences are no longer available.
paragraphs.zh: 受人类因果认知的启发，我们提出了 CauProphet（图 1），一个通过经验积累并完善因果知识的大语言模型智能体。 在 CauProphet 中，因果认知将智能体所学的内容围绕反复出现的因素、这些因素如何影响结果、以及这些关系成立的条件来加以组织。 面对新任务时，智能体会检查哪些保留的解释符合当前情况，并将其与当前证据结合，形成因果信念。 这种结构化的信念描述了什么会影响结果，以及可能的行动如何改变结果，从而指导智能体的决策。 因此，随着任务及其证据的变化，同一认知可以形成不同的信念。 随着观测的到来，智能体会修订当前的信念，并用被选出的、可能为后续决策提供依据的发现来更新因果认知。 通过这一循环，即使原始经验不再可用，因果理解依然能够保持有效。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments demonstrate that CauProphet progressively develops causal knowledge from experience and applies it to improve decisions in subsequent tasks. We first test whether knowledge retained from earlier tasks improves subsequent financial research, with each task beginning in a fresh context. CauProphet outperforms all baselines in mean correlation between predicted and actual rankings of next-day stock returns, with a 25.4% relative gain over an agent with text memory. To test how causal understanding supports judgments across domains as new evidence arrives, we also evaluate predictions made while real-world events unfold. Prediction accuracy increases from 21.3% for a baseline agent to 28.6% for CauProphet . Further tests validate the causal analysis and action selection needed for these complex tasks, with scientific and everyday applications broadening the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验表明，CauProphet 能够从经验中逐步发展出因果知识，并将其应用于后续任务以改进决策。 我们首先测试从早期任务中保留的知识能否改进后续的金融研究，其中每个任务都在全新的上下文中开始。 在预测排名与次日股票实际排名之间的平均相关性上，CauProphet 优于所有基线，相对于具有文本记忆的智能体取得了 25.4% 的相对提升。 为了测试因果理解如何在新证据出现时支持跨领域的判断，我们还在现实世界事件展开的过程中对预测进行了评估。 预测准确率从基线智能体的 21.3% 提升到 CauProphet 的 28.6%。 进一步的测试验证了这些复杂任务所需的因果分析与行动选择，科学和日常应用则拓宽了评估范围。

paragraphs.en: We introduce CauProphet , an LLM agent that accumulates causal knowledge from experience to develop its Causal Cognition. For each task, it combines relevant knowledge from Causal Cognition with current evidence to form Causal Belief, which guides decisions. New observations refine both the belief and the knowledge retained for future tasks.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents combine reasoning, memory, planning, and tool use [ Wang et al., 2024 ] . ReAct [ Yao et al., 2023 ] and Toolformer [ Schick et al., 2023 ] connect language models with external actions. System design shapes these capabilities [ Liu et al., 2026 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ] , and evaluations distinguish its contribution from that of the base model [ Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ] . MemGPT [ Packer et al., 2023 ] , retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) [ Lewis et al., 2020 ] , and Markdown notes in Claude Code [ Anthropic, 2025b ] support information retention and access beyond the current context. These mechanisms leave open how agents can, like humans, develop causal understanding from experience and use it to guide new decisions without recalling every event that shaped it.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体结合了推理、记忆、规划与工具使用 [ Wang et al., 2024 ] 。 ReAct [ Yao et al., 2023 ] 和 Toolformer [ Schick et al., 2023 ] 将语言模型与外部行动连接起来。 系统设计塑造了这些能力 [ Liu et al., 2026 ; Lopopolo, 2026 ; Ning et al., 2026 ] ，而评估则将其贡献与基础模型的贡献区分开来 [ Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ] 。 MemGPT [ Packer et al., 2023 ] 、检索增强生成（RAG）[ Lewis et al., 2020 ] 以及 Claude Code 中的 Markdown 笔记 [ Anthropic, 2025b ] 支持超出当前上下文的信息保留与访问。 这些机制留下了一个未解之题：智能体能否像人类一样，从经验中发展出因果理解，并利用它来指导新的决策，而无需回忆起塑造这一理解的每一个事件。

sents.zh: 这些机制留下了一个未解之题：智能体能否像人类一样，从经验中发展出因果理解，并利用它来指导新的决策，而无需回忆起塑造这一理解的每一个事件。

paragraphs.en: Kiciman et al. [2024] examine LLM knowledge for causal discovery and reasoning, emphasizing checks against evidence. Causal-LLM [ Roy et al., 2025 ] , CauScientist [ Peng et al., 2026a ] , and CauTion [ Peng et al., 2026b ] develop LLM-assisted methods for causal graph discovery. Causal-Copilot [ Wang et al., 2025 ] and the Causal AI Scientist [ Verma et al., 2025 ] automate causal analysis workflows, while Causal Agent [ Han et al., 2026 ] combines causal tools with iterative reasoning and graph memory. InferenceEvolve [ Wang et al., 2026 ] develops and evaluates causal effect estimators. Their emphasis is on producing and assessing causal structures, estimates, or analysis methods. Reusing findings beyond the original analysis also requires retaining what relationship was learned and under which conditions it holds. CauProphet focuses on how these findings become causal understanding that can guide subsequent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Kiciman 等人 [2024] 考察了大型语言模型在因果发现与因果推理方面的知识，强调对照证据进行检验。 Causal-LLM [ Roy 等人， 2025 ]、CauScientist [ Peng 等人， 2026a ] 和 CauTion [ Peng 等人， 2026b ] 开发了借助大型语言模型的因果图发现方法。 Causal-Copilot [ Wang 等人， 2025 ] 和 Causal AI Scientist [ Verma 等人， 2025 ] 实现了因果分析工作流的自动化，而 Causal Agent [ Han 等人， 2026 ] 则将因果工具与迭代推理和图记忆相结合。 InferenceEvolve [ Wang 等人， 2026 ] 开发并评估因果效应估计器。 它们的重点在于生成和评估因果结构、估计结果或分析方法。 要在原始分析之外复用这些发现，还需要保留所学到的关系是什么以及它在何种条件下成立。 CauProphet 关注的是这些发现如何转化为能够指导后续任务的因果理解。

paragraphs.en: Causal knowledge also guides agent behavior. Causal-aware LLMs [ Chen et al., 2025 ] learn and update environmental causal models for action selection, while CausalPlan [ Nguyen et al., 2025 ] learns causal relationships for planning and coordination. CausalEvolve [ Chen et al., 2026a ] uses a “causal scratchpad” to retain findings that guide program revisions, while CausalFlow [ Bonagiri et al., 2026 ] uses counterfactual analysis to repair execution failures. These approaches organize causal reasoning around environment dynamics, program performance, or execution repair. Yet developing lasting abstract causal cognition inspired by human learning from experience remains underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 因果知识同样能引导智能体的行为。 因果感知大语言模型 [ Chen et al., 2025 ] 学习并更新环境因果模型以选择动作，而 CausalPlan [ Nguyen et al., 2025 ] 则学习因果关系以实现规划与协调。 CausalEvolve [ Chen et al., 2026a ] 使用“因果便笺”来保留指导程序修订的发现，而 CausalFlow [ Bonagiri et al., 2026 ] 则利用反事实分析来修复执行失败。 这些方法将因果推理围绕环境动态、程序性能或执行修复来组织。 然而，受人类从经验中学习启发、发展持久的抽象因果认知，这一方向仍鲜有探索。

paragraphs.en: CauProphet learns causal relationships from experience and leverages them to guide new decisions (Figure 2 ). The agent accumulates these relationships and their conditions to build Causal Cognition, reflecting how human beings develop lasting understanding from experience. To apply this accumulated understanding to a new task, the agent combines relevant knowledge from Causal Cognition with current evidence to form a structured Causal Belief. This belief describes what influences the outcome and how possible actions could change it, guiding the agent’s decisions.
paragraphs.zh: CauProphet 从经验中学习因果关系，并利用它们来指导新的决策（图 2）。 智能体积累这些因果关系及其条件，构建因果认知（Causal Cognition），这反映了人类如何从经验中形成持久的理解。 为了将这种积累的理解应用于新任务，智能体将因果认知中的相关知识与时下的证据相结合，形成结构化的因果信念（Causal Belief）。 这种信念描述了哪些因素会影响结果，以及可能的行动会如何改变结果，从而指导智能体的决策。

paragraphs.en: We view each task as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), where the agent relies on a belief about an environment it cannot fully observe [ Kaelbling et al., 1998 ] . To investigate competing explanations, the agent uses Causal Scout to compare alternatives and suggest observations that could distinguish them. As observations arrive, CauProphet revises the belief and updates Causal Cognition, retaining causal knowledge that remains useful beyond the individual experiences from which it was learned.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个任务视为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），其中智能体依赖于对无法完全观测的环境的信念 [ Kaelbling et al., 1998 ] 。 为了研究相互竞争的解释，智能体使用 Causal Scout 来比较各种备选解释，并建议可以区分它们的观测。 随着观测的到来，CauProphet 修正信念并更新 Causal Cognition，保留那些在习得它们的单个经验之外仍然有用的因果知识。

paragraphs.en: Causal Cognition organizes retained knowledge around explanations of how recurring factors influence one another, together with their conditions, time scales, evidence, and unresolved questions. Its graph connects these factors through proposed causal relationships. Written explanations describe mechanisms and their evidence in natural language and can be revised without first constructing a graph. In both forms, the explanation can be checked against a new task and revised as evidence changes, even after the original interaction is no longer available.
paragraphs.zh: 因果认知围绕“反复出现的因素如何相互影响”的解释来组织留存的知识，同时涵盖这些解释的条件、时间尺度、证据以及尚未解决的问题。 它的图通过提出的因果关系将这些因素连接起来。 书面解释用自然语言描述机制及其证据，并且可以在尚未构建图的情况下进行修订。 在这两种形式中，即使最初的交互已不可用，解释也可以对照新任务进行检查，并随证据的变化而修订。

paragraphs.en: When prior knowledge could help, the agent searches Causal Cognition using the user’s goal and current circumstances. It follows graph connections to find relevant factors and possible paths of influence, and retrieves written explanations of related mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 当先验知识可能有所帮助时，智能体会根据用户的目标和当前情况搜索因果认知。 它沿着图中的连接找到相关因素和可能的影响路径，并检索相关机制的书面解释。

paragraphs.en: The model adapts this knowledge to the task: it maps recurring factors to current variables, checks conditions and time scales against current evidence, and examines observations that challenge the explanation. Adopted relationships form the working graph in Causal Belief; the agent also records current facts, assumptions, and open questions. For retrieved written explanations, the model records how they apply to the current situation in the belief. Thus, the same retained knowledge can inform different beliefs as task conditions and evidence change. The resulting belief guides actions, and causal analysis tools can use its graph to estimate effects.
paragraphs.zh: 模型将这些知识适配到任务中：它把反复出现的因素映射到当前变量，根据当前证据检查条件与时间尺度，并审视那些对该解释构成挑战的观测。 被采纳的关系在「因果信念」中形成工作图；智能体还会记录当前事实、假设与待解决的问题。 对于检索到的书面解释，模型会在信念中记录它们如何适用于当前情境。 因此，同一份被保留的知识可以随任务条件与证据的变化，支撑不同的信念。 由此形成的信念会指导行动，而因果分析工具可以利用其中的图来估计效应。

Rules enforce required and forbidden relationships, exclude incompatible hypotheses, prevent directed cycles, and respect known temporal order.

paragraphs.en: Candidates are also checked against available statistical test results. paragraphs.en: To study how agents develop and reuse causal knowledge over time, we use AlphaBench [ Luo et al., 2026 ] . Its factor-search task asks agents to construct formulas that rank stocks by their predicted next-day returns, combining numerical trends with hypotheses about market behavior. We follow two six-period studies—price-and-volume research in 2014–2016 and volume-only research in 2017–2019—in which the agent commits a formula before receiving next-period feedback (Figure 3 ). Each task starts in a fresh context; agents with memory can retrieve earlier findings and revise them after feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究智能体如何随时间发展并复用因果知识，我们使用 AlphaBench [Luo et al., 2026]。 其因子搜索任务要求智能体构建根据预测的次日收益对股票进行排序的公式，将数值趋势与关于市场行为的假设相结合。 我们进行了两项各含六个周期的研究——2014–2016 年的价量研究和 2017–2019 年的纯成交量研究——其中智能体在提交公式后才收到下一周期的反馈（图 3）。 每个任务都在全新的上下文中开始；拥有记忆的智能体可以检索先前的发现，并在收到反馈后对其进行修订。

paragraphs.en: RankIC measures agreement between predicted and realized return rankings. Across the two chronological studies, CauProphet achieves the highest mean score, outperforming ReAct, OpenCode, and ReAct with text memory (Table 1 ). In price research, CauProphet retains its hypothesis that a five-day decline may precede a rebound after testing alternatives. In volume research, CauProphet initially retains the hypothesis that stocks with trading volume below their historical average may have higher next-day returns. Later feedback shows that this hypothesis performs differently across periods. The agent incorporates this finding into its retained explanation. The updated explanation then guides tests of how to combine recent and longer-term trading volume and informs revisions to the prediction formula.
paragraphs.zh: RankIC 衡量预测收益率排名与实际收益率排名之间的一致程度。 在两项时间顺序研究中，CauProphet 取得了最高的平均分数，优于 ReAct、OpenCode 以及带文本记忆的 ReAct（表 1）。 在价格研究中，CauProphet 在检验了其他备选假设后，仍保留「五天下跌之后可能出现反弹」的假设。 在成交量研究中，CauProphet 最初保留「成交量低于其历史平均水平的股票次日收益率可能更高」的假设。 后续反馈显示，该假设在不同时期的表现并不一致。 该智能体将这一发现纳入其保留的解释之中。 更新后的解释随后指导了对如何结合近期与较长期成交量进行检验，并为预测公式的修订提供依据。

paragraphs.en: A complementary five-round study examines knowledge reuse during repeated formula search on the same historical dataset (Figure 4 ). The Causal Cognition workflow’s mean held-out score rises from 4.213 to 4.850 in Round 4 and finishes at 4.820, while text memory remains at 4.191 across all five rounds. paragraphs.en: We further examine whether causal understanding helps agents draw inferences across diverse domains as evidence accumulates over time. Using FutureSim [ Goel et al., 2026 ; OpenForecaster, 2026 ] , we follow 24 OpenForesight forecasting questions [ Chandak et al., 2026 ] as news becomes available in chronological order. This yields 195 question–day predictions per system, including 171 before resolution. Brier Skill Score (BSS) rewards probability assigned to the eventual answer and penalizes confident mistakes; pre-resolution scores average within each question, then across questions. Figure 5 tracks prediction quality as the replay unfolds. CauProphet achieves the highest BSS and Top-1 accuracy before events resolve (Table 2 ). This advantage concerns judgments made while an event is unfolding, when decisions still need to be made.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步检验，随着证据随时间不断积累，因果理解是否有助于智能体跨多个领域进行推断。 使用 FutureSim [ Goel et al., 2026 ; OpenForecaster, 2026 ]，我们跟随 24 个 OpenForesight 预测问题 [ Chandak et al., 2026 ]，按时间顺序在新闻陆续发布时进行跟踪。 这为每个系统产生了 195 个问题–日的预测，其中 171 个是在结果揭晓之前做出的。 Brier 技能分数（BSS）对最终答案被赋予的概率给予奖励，并对自信的错误进行惩罚；先在每个问题内部对结果揭晓前的分数取平均，再跨问题取平均。 图 5 展示了回放过程中预测质量的变化。 CauProphet 在事件揭晓之前取得了最高的 BSS 和 Top-1 准确率（表 2 ）。 这一优势涉及的是在事件仍在展开、而决策仍需做出的时刻所作的判断。

paragraphs.en: Causal reasoning in the complex tasks above depends on basic abilities to identify causal relationships, estimate how actions affect outcomes, and choose interventions. We therefore test these foundations directly using fixed datasets with known causal mechanisms and an interactive environment.
paragraphs.zh: 上述复杂任务中的因果推理依赖于一些基本能力，即识别因果关系、估计动作如何影响结果以及选择干预措施。 因此，我们使用具有已知因果机制的固定数据集和一个交互式环境直接测试这些基础能力。

paragraphs.en: To test causal analysis against known answers, we use data from three structural causal models (SCMs), whose equations define the causal relationships and intervention effects. They include two nonlinear systems and one linear system, each with 800 observations. CauProphet has the lowest mean effect relative error in all three and gets the effect direction correct in all nine evaluations (Figure 6 ). ReAct finds a valid set of variables to account for when estimating effects in the eleven-node system but reverses every effect direction. Accurate causal analysis requires both recovering relationships and estimating how interventions change the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在已知答案上检验因果分析，我们使用来自三个结构因果模型（SCM）的数据，其方程定义了因果关系和干预效应。 它们包括两个非线性系统和一个线性系统，每个系统有 800 个观测值。 CauProphet 在全部三个模型中平均效应相对误差最低，并且在全部九次评估中都正确判断了效应方向（图 6）。 ReAct 在估计十一节点系统中的效应时能找到一组有效的需考虑变量，但把每个效应方向都搞反了。 准确的因果分析既需要恢复关系，也需要估计干预如何改变结果。

paragraphs.en: We then move from causal structure discovery and effect estimation on fixed datasets to choosing interventions in an interactive environment. We use CausalGame [ Chen et al., 2026b ] , a simulated drone adventure, to test whether causal understanding guides actions when agents have only partial information about their surroundings. CauProphet has higher mean survival and score than ReAct and OpenCode in all three scenarios, winning every run in both trap scenarios (Figure 7 ). The complete system also exceeds both ablations: joint removal of Causal Belief, Causal Cognition, and Causal Scout with causal computation retained, and removal of all dedicated causal capabilities. The results connect causal analysis to the consequences of actions; computation tools alone do not recover the complete system’s performance.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们从固定数据集上的因果结构发现和效应估计，转向在交互环境中选择干预。 我们使用 CausalGame [Chen et al., 2026b]——一个模拟的无人机冒险环境——来检验当智能体对其周围环境仅有部分信息时，因果理解是否能指导其行动。 在所有三个场景中，CauProphet 的平均存活率和得分都高于 ReAct 和 OpenCode，并且在两个陷阱场景中赢得了每一次运行（图 7）。 完整系统也超过了两个消融版本：一个是保留因果计算但移除因果信念（Causal Belief）、因果认知（Causal Cognition）和因果侦察（Causal Scout）的版本，另一个是移除所有专用因果能力的版本。 这些结果将因果分析与行动后果联系起来；仅有计算工具无法恢复完整系统的性能。

paragraphs.en: To examine how agents answer scientific questions through data analysis, we evaluate 12 tasks from BLADE [ Gu et al., 2024 ] , spanning education, social behavior, ecology, health, and economic decisions. Model match measures agreement with the reference statistical model; variable match measures agreement on the selected variables. Transformation match checks the resulting data values and how the processing steps connect. CauProphet matches the best model selection, achieves the highest transformation match rates, and improves variable match over ReAct (Figure 8 ). The clearest gains concern data preparation: causal questions must be translated into the observations and comparisons that answer them.
paragraphs.zh: 为了考察智能体如何通过数据分析回答科学问题，我们在 BLADE [ Gu et al., 2024 ] 的 12 个任务上进行评估，这些任务涵盖教育、社会行为、生态学、健康和经济决策。 模型匹配衡量与参考统计模型的一致性；变量匹配衡量所选变量的一致性。 变换匹配检查所得的数据值以及各处理步骤之间的衔接方式。 CauProphet 匹配到了最佳模型选择，取得了最高的变换匹配率，并在变量匹配上优于 ReAct（图 8）。 最明显的提升体现在数据准备方面：因果问题必须被转化为能够回答它们的观测和比较。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we examine action selection in everyday applications using AppWorld [ Trivedi et al., 2024 ] , with tasks involving music, messaging, expenses, files, and shopping. Across 23 completed executions of 16 selected tasks, CauProphet passes 173 of 174 checks (Table 3 ). These tasks connect action selection to changes in everyday applications.

paragraphs.en: We introduced CauProphet to study how agents can build causal understanding from experience, much as human beings do. By connecting Causal Cognition with Causal Belief, the agent applies retained causal relationships and their conditions to new situations, combining them with current evidence to guide decisions. Findings from these tasks can contribute to the causal knowledge available for later use. Experiments show that earlier findings guide subsequent research and that CauProphet makes more accurate predictions while events unfold. Further evaluations examine the basic causal abilities underlying these tasks and applications to scientific analysis and everyday activities. These results support our approach to developing agents whose causal understanding extends beyond individual experiences and informs new decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 CauProphet，以研究智能体如何像人类一样从经验中构建因果理解。 通过连接因果认知与因果信念，智能体将保留的因果关系及其条件应用于新情境，并与当前证据相结合来指导决策。 这些任务的发现可以成为可供后续使用的因果知识。 实验表明，早期发现会指导后续研究，并且 CauProphet 在事件展开的过程中能做出更准确的预测。 进一步的评估考察了这些任务所依赖的基本因果能力，以及其在科学分析和日常活动中的应用。 这些结果支持了我们开发智能体的方法，使智能体的因果理解超越个体经验并为新的决策提供依据。

paragraphs.en: This case follows how an everyday conversation changes the agent’s understanding of an observed pattern. The user asks whether an increase in reported cases after expanded testing means that an outbreak is worsening. The interaction moves from an explanation of this particular observation to a retained relationship about how testing conditions influence what is measured.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例展示了日常对话如何改变智能体对某一观察到的模式的理解。 用户询问扩大检测后报告病例增加是否意味着疫情正在恶化。 该交互从对这一特定观察的解释，推进到一个被保留的关系，即检测条件如何影响所测量的内容。

paragraphs.en: The user asks for a short answer, without requesting a causal graph or analysis tools. CauProphet creates a Causal Belief with four variables and three edges. Its explanation separates the underlying infections from the process through which testing makes cases observable: reported cases can change when either infections or detection changes. The task-local belief gives the agent an explicit account of the factors behind the observation (Figure 9 A).
paragraphs.zh: 用户要求一个简短的回答，没有要求因果图或分析工具。 CauProphet 创建了一个包含四个变量和三条边的因果信念。 它的解释将潜在感染与检测使病例可被观察的过程分离开来：当感染或检出任一发生变化时，报告病例都可能发生变化。 这个任务局部的信念为智能体提供了对观测背后因素的明确解释（图 9 A）。

paragraphs.en: The user then asks what happens if testing mainly expands among people who already feel ill. This introduces a condition about who is tested. CauProphet incorporates testing indication and test positivity into the same belief, expanding it to six variables and seven edges. The revised explanation considers how the composition of the tested group influences positivity, alongside the contribution of underlying infections (Figures 9 B and 10 C). The new information therefore changes the relationships used to interpret the observation.
paragraphs.zh: 用户接着问，如果检测主要在已经感到不适的人群中扩大，会发生什么。 这引入了一个关于检测对象的条件。 CauProphet 将检测指征和检测阳性率纳入同一信念中，将其扩展为六个变量和七条边。 修订后的解释考虑了被检测人群的构成如何影响阳性率，以及潜在感染的贡献（图 9 B 和图 10 C）。 因此，新信息改变了用于解读观测结果的关系。

paragraphs.en: During the cognition update, CauProphet maps testing intensity to an existing surveillance-intensity concept and retains the selected testing-indication–positivity relationship with its source episode (Figure 10 D). The retained explanation describes how symptom-targeted testing can change the observed positivity rate and records that interpreting its trend depends on the testing strategy remaining roughly constant.
paragraphs.zh: 在认知更新过程中，CauProphet 将检测强度映射到已有的监测强度概念，并保留所选的检测指征–阳性率关系及其来源情节（图 10 D）。 所保留的解释描述了针对症状的检测如何改变观察到的阳性率，并记录了解读其趋势需要检测策略大致保持不变这一前提。

paragraphs.en: The resulting knowledge is expressed through recurring factors, a relationship between them, and a condition on its use. The source episode records where the explanation came from; the relationship and its condition provide the content that can be considered in another task. paragraphs.en: An experience can suggest that one factor influences another under particular conditions. Causal Cognition retains the recurring factors and proposed relationship, together with a mechanism, time scale, and supporting or conflicting evidence. For graph knowledge, a source link connects the relationship to the experience that motivated it. In the testing case in Appendix A , the retained explanation concerns how symptom-targeted testing affects observed positivity. paragraphs.en: We use CSI300 stock data to search for formulas that rank stocks by predicted next-day close-to-close returns. paragraphs.en: In the price study, CauProphet retrieves the hypothesis that stocks whose prices fell over the preceding five days tend to rebound the next day. It tests shorter and longer horizons, moving-average alternatives, and additional volume or volatility weighting, while retaining the five-day reversal formula across all six periods (Table 6 ). After feedback, the retained explanation incorporates the new period’s outcome and comparisons with alternatives. The formula stays the same while the accumulated account of where it has worked and which variants have been tested becomes more detailed.
paragraphs.zh: 在价格研究中，CauProphet 检索出这样一个假设：过去五天内价格下跌的股票往往会在第二天反弹。 它检验了更短和更长的时间跨度、移动平均的替代方案，以及额外的成交量或波动率加权，同时在全部六个期间保留五日反转公式（表 6）。 在获得反馈后，被保留的解释会纳入新期间的的结果以及与各种替代方案的比较。 公式本身保持不变，而关于它在哪些情况下有效、哪些变体已被检验的累积记录则变得更加详细。

paragraphs.en: The volume study starts from the hypothesis that low current volume relative to a historical baseline may precede higher next-day returns. After weaker subsequent performance, CauProphet records that the signal’s strength varies across periods. Later searches compare longer and shorter baselines and combine 120-day and 20-day relative-volume terms. Following feedback from 2019H1, the next search retains this combined form but compares alternative recent baselines, selecting 10 days for 2019H2. The retained understanding thus changes both its assessment of persistence and the formula variants considered in later tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 成交量研究始于这样一个假设：相对于历史基准而言较低的当前成交量，可能预示次日更高的收益。 在随后的表现转弱之后，CauProphet 记录到该信号的强度在不同时期有所变化。 后续搜索比较了较长和较短的基准，并将 120 日与 20 日的相对成交量项组合在一起。 根据 2019 上半年的反馈，下一次搜索保留了这一组合形式，但比较了不同的近期基准，并为 2019 下半年选择了 10 天。 因此，所保留的理解既改变了对持续性的评估，也改变了后续任务中所考虑的公式变体。

paragraphs.en: In the fixed-data study, the third-round BETA execution retrieves a lesson comparing volume weights applied to a relative price decline with weights applied to a raw price ratio. It re-evaluates a previous candidate, then compares reversal horizons and volatility windows before submitting a revised formula. Subsequent rounds revisit the volatility window and weighting choice. These traces illustrate how retained explanations and measured comparisons enter later searches and are supplemented by new outcomes.

sents.zh: 该回复明确说明了其假设与不确定性。
